rawScenePlan.consequence: A glossy, inked smear streaks from the deli counter across the aisle toward a promotional crate of stickers; several meat trays lie askew with tags stuck to them.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: an iridescent cleaning bottle knocked from a lower shelf will strike the crate of stickers, spreading a rainbow sheen along the smear.

rawScenePlan.title: Alarm and Reveal
rawScenePlan.event: Someone screams 'Terror!' A distant siren flares; the store’s emergency announcement loops and a few security shutters descend. rawScenePlan.title: Checkout Ritual

As it swings down it snags a rail of printed price-tickets; the rail unspools and dozens of paper tags scatter across the floor and down an escalator.
appliedScenePlan.consequence: A fan-shaped scatter of price-tags and one torn, dangling sign panel lying across the tile between escalator and entrance.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: damp, inked price-tags trail toward the deli counter and leave smudges on the floor.
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Handheld candid close-to-mid shot inside the recognizable Kaufhaus central corridor. Slight camera shake, autofocus hunting as an overhead illuminated department sign rips free and unspools a rail of paper price-tags that flutter down the escalator. Natural exposure swings between store fluorescents and the emergency amber flash. Visible consequence: a fan of paper tags across the tiles and a torn panel lying on the floor near the escalator. Texture: mobile-device compression, soft motion blur on falling paper.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Handheld mobile-phone style: candid, slightly shaky framing, autofocus breathing and brief exposure bounce as the ceiling sign seizes and rips loose; camera lurches forward as tickets unspool and flutter down. Capture rolling shutter/compression artifacts on the fastest passes. Sound: distant PA hum and a metallic whine as the panel abrades the mounting. Camera reveals the torn sign and scattered tags with a slow push-in.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: After the panel tears loose, push in and tilt down to follow the unspooling tags to the floor; hold on the piled tags so the displaced pattern reads as a visible problem.

appliedScenePlan.title: Deli Labels
appliedScenePlan.event: A cluster of fallen price-tags drifts to the deli counter. A tray of packaged cold cuts is accidentally nudged; a smear of brine and glaze from the packaging transfers ink from nearby price-tags, producing dark, fraktur-like letterforms across the metal counter and tile—one readable word: 'Fleisch'—as labels stick and curl.
appliedScenePlan.consequence: A glossy, inked smear streaks from the deli counter across the aisle toward a promotional crate of stickers; several meat trays lie askew with tags stuck to them.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: an iridescent cleaning bottle knocked from a lower shelf will strike the crate of stickers, spreading a rainbow sheen along the smear.
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Close-to-mid handheld shot of the deli counter within the Kaufhaus: plastic-wrapped meat trays jostle, gloss and brine smear ink from price-tags into dark, old-style letterforms on metal—one label visibly reads 'Fleisch.' Slight camera shake, AF breathing, subtle overexposure on reflective stainless. Keep the store's shelving, deli lights, and tiled floor clearly recognizable.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Handheld, candid mobile recording: small tremor as the camera follows a drifting tag to the deli counter; autofocus hunts on the wet surface as ink smears into fraktur-like letters. Natural exposure swings across stainless reflections; brief motion blur as a tray tips and tags adhere. Capture small compression blocking on bright metal highlights.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: After the trays tip, dolly slightly laterally (handheld) to reveal the ink smear leading off toward a promotional crate; hold so the 'Fleisch' mark is readable in frame center.

appliedScenePlan.title: Iridescent Identifier
appliedScenePlan.event: A low promotional crate of glossed stickers and leaflets (printed with a small DOI-like barcode) is struck by a dropped bottle of fluorescent floor-cleaner; the bottle ruptures and the liquid spreads over the ink smear, refracting into a thin, oily rainbow sheen on tile. A brief chemical fizz lifts a single sticker which adheres against the riser of the escalator. Behind a glass display a silhouette presses a textured face to the pane and then slides slowly away (a quick, partial reveal of the creature's bark-like features and amber eyes).
appliedScenePlan.consequence: An iridescent crescent-shaped sheen across the floor leading to the escalator and a DOI-style sticker stuck to the escalator riser.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: shoppers approach the escalator to touch the shimmering floor and the sticker, drawing a small crowd.
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Handheld mobile-frame inside the Kaufhaus focused on the floor: fluorescent cleaner spills over an ink smear and forms an oily rainbow sheen across the tiles; a promotional sticker printed with a small DOI-style barcode adheres to the escalator riser. Brief reflected outline: a textured, leaf-edged ear and a sliver of bark-like face reflected in a nearby glass display (no full creature body shown). Natural AF breathing, slight handheld sway, modest compression blur.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Candid handheld recording: camera follows the spill as it spreads into a shimmering, prismatic film. Autofocus hunts between tile texture and the reflective sheen; exposure bounces on highlights of the liquid. At one beat the camera catches a brief, mirrored silhouette in glass—a quick reveal of bark-textured skin and an amber eye through reflection—then slides away. Include subtle motion blur and mobile compression artifacts.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: After the bottle ruptures, tilt down and track the spreading sheen to the escalator riser; as the camera reaches the escalator, rotate to catch the quick mirrored reflection in the glass before cutting.

appliedScenePlan.title: Gathering Crowd
appliedScenePlan.event: The DOI-sticker on the escalator and the iridescent floor draw attention: a handful of shoppers stop, then more converge. Phones come up; a small cluster forms and fingers prod the shimmering tile. One shopper slips on the oily sheen and a stroller overturns, scattering a child's toy and an unattended smartphone onto the aisle. A ring of people tighten around the escalator, phones recording, murmurs rising.
appliedScenePlan.consequence: An abandoned smartphone with a cracked corner face-up on the tile, its camera app open and a half-fired photo frozen on screen; the stroller and scattered toy lie nearby.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: the fallen phone's frozen image will be reviewed and will show an accidental capture that changes the crowd's behavior.
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Handheld candid close-to-mid shot in the Kaufhaus capturing shoppers clustering at the escalator: phones raised, a stroller tipped on its side, a child's toy on the tiled floor, and a cracked smartphone face-up with its camera app open. Natural autofocus shifts between faces and the shimmering floor; store fixtures and commercial signage keep the location unmistakable. Slight exposure shifts and phone-camera compression artifacts visible on bright reflections.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Handheld mobile footage: a small crowd forms as people point phones at the iridescent sheen; autofocus and exposure hunt across faces. Someone slips—camera stumbles—revealing the overturned stroller and a phone on the floor still recording with its screen frozen. Ambient store noise crescendos into murmured questions. Keep framing candid and jittery, with real-phone artifacting.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: After the slip, snap down to the cracked phone on the floor and hold close to its screen so the frozen capture is legible even as the crowd blurs around the edges.

appliedScenePlan.title: Alarm and Reveal
appliedScenePlan.event: Someone screams 'Terror!' A distant siren flares; the store’s emergency announcement loops and a few security shutters descend. In the scramble a display of mannequins topples; where one falls it rips open a rack of clothing and a hidden form shifts—a creature steps out between draped shirts, amber eyes catching the flashing emergency lights. It does not attack; it moves slowly, trunk-like mouth flexing, then lifts a limp mannequin arm as if holding something.
appliedScenePlan.consequence: Toppled mannequins and a cleared patch of floor that shows the creature's muddy footprints leading away from the rack toward the checkout aisles.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: muddy, irregular footprints track across the tile toward the front registers and a checkout conveyor left running unattended.
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Handheld, candid mid-close of the Kaufhaus clothing section during an emergency: mannequins collapsed, a slow-moving bark-textured creature pushing up from between racks—visible upper body with glowing amber eyes and leaf-edged ears—under emergency strobes and store fluorescents. Keep the Kaufhaus interior signage, shelving, and tiled floor evident. Camera texture: mobile shake, autofocus breathing, slight motion blur.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Mobile-device style footage: a shouted alarm, camera jostle as people run off-frame, then a handheld push into collapsed mannequins reveals the creature emerging between clothing racks. The creature's face fills the frame briefly—bark-like skin, elongated leaf-edges to the ears, amber eyes—lit by alternating emergency strobes and warm shop lights. Include AF hunting, exposure swings, and modest compression artifacts.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: After the mannequins fall, hand-follow a single muddy footprint and then whip to the creature as it leverages itself up into the light; hold tight on its face for a beat before cutting.

appliedScenePlan.title: Checkout Ritual
appliedScenePlan.event: A sudden change in behavior: instead of full flight some shoppers begin pocketing small items and racing to cash registers; others, frozen, point at the creature. The creature stands in the cleared aisle, surprisingly calm, and—mirroring the store's purpose—picks up a torn price-tag and presses it to a canvas shopping bag. A frightened cashier continues to feed the unattended conveyor as if on autopilot; the monster mimics the motion of swapping a sticker onto the bag, then steps back as a receipt flutters from the register onto the floor.
appliedScenePlan.consequence: A single canvas shopping bag on the checkout conveyor with a DOI-style sticker and a crushed price-tag attached; a receipt lies under it with a smudge of the earlier iridescent cleaner.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: the prepared bag with sticker will leave the conveyor as the final visible residue—consumption reframing the panic.
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Handheld close-to-mid shot at the Kaufhaus checkout lane: a creature with a bark-textured face and amber eyes calmly presses a torn price-tag and a DOI-style sticker onto a canvas shopping bag on a moving conveyor while shoppers either grab items or freeze. Cashier hands still move over a running register. Mobile-device texture: small shake, AF breathing, exposure flicker from ceiling lighting, mild compression artifacts on highlights.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: Candid handheld recording: camera follows the conveyor belt as a creature places a tag and DOI-style sticker onto a canvas bag; the cashier absentmindedly continues scanning. Autofocus drifts between the creature's hands and the conveyor; exposure bounces on glossy packaging and register LEDs. Sound: scanner beeps, murmured panic turning into frantic consumption. Keep Kaufhaus details—register signage, store branding—visible.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: After the creature adheres the sticker, push in low across the conveyor to show the bag, the receipt with iridescent smudge, and the creature's hands, then tilt up to hold on the creature's face as the belt moves the bag forward.
